subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-inject SKILL.md content when skill is invoked via slash command

question: Should explicit non-tool skill slash commands automatically inject SKILL.md content into model context, and what authority boundary should that injected content have?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes how potentially untrusted skill instructions enter model context and how that interacts with existing tool-dispatch, Skill-loader, and instruction-isolation contracts.

options.title: Define Guarded Core Injection
options.body: Implement slash-invoked SKILL.md loading only after defining untrusted-content delimiters, precedence rules, eligibility checks, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Prefer A Skill Loader Contract
options.body: Route explicit skill invocations through a dedicated Skill-style tool or plugin capability instead of hidden prompt injection.

options.title: Keep Advisory Routing
options.body: Document current model-routed behavior as intentional and direct deterministic workflows to command-dispatch: tool or a future plugin API.

recommendation.title: Define Guarded Core Injection
recommendation.body: Implement slash-invoked SKILL.md loading only after defining untrusted-content delimiters, precedence rules, eligibility checks, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the user-invocable skill command surface and is the strongest history signal for the prompt/security decision.
